svg.text: Diode array order on the board: now and proposed
A dot is a key (colored by node). A line is its node bus to the array column. D0..D6 is the MCU pad that column reaches.
Now: array columns K1..K7 (186 line crossings)
Left and right lines interleave and cross above the array. D0..D6 = P1..P7.
Proposed: K1, K7, K6, K2, K4, K3, K5 (23 line crossings)
Best of all 5040 orders for these key positions. D0..D6 = P1, P7, P6, P2, P4, P3, P5.
